title: Keep left
spokenText: Drive on the left side of the road and stay attentive to pedestrians and other vehicles.
details: Japan Automobile Federation guidance states that drivers and cyclists must keep to the left, while pedestrians should keep to the right side of the road.

title: Do not turn on red
spokenText: At a red signal, do not turn left or right unless a green arrow permits your direction.
details: JAF explains that cars generally may not turn left or right on red. A green arrow can permit travel in its indicated direction even while the main signal is red.

title: Seatbelts and attention
spokenText: Everyone must wear a seatbelt, and the driver must not use a phone or become distracted by navigation while moving.
details: JAF lists seatbelt use for the driver and all passengers and prohibits phone use or distraction by the navigation system while driving.

title: Keep right
spokenText: Keep to the right side of the road and overtake only when the way is clear.
details: The LTO Filipino Driver's Manual explains Philippine lane discipline and requires drivers to make overtaking and passing maneuvers only when the opposing side is clearly visible and free of oncoming traffic for a safe distance.

title: Check intersections
spokenText: Slow down at intersections and check for crossing vehicles and pedestrians.
details: The LTO manual's road-safety guidance requires drivers to approach intersections carefully, observe right-of-way controls, and check conflicting traffic before proceeding.

title: Follow traffic signals
spokenText: Follow traffic lights, signs, and road markings before turning or proceeding.
details: The LTO Filipino Driver's Manual presents traffic lights, regulatory signs, warning signs, and pavement markings as controls drivers must observe on Philippine roads.
